preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 100.
The number of teams n in each test case must be between 2 and 100.

postconditions.description: The output must contain the correct number of game results for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(score == total_points // n for score in team_scores)
postconditions.description: All teams must have the same score, which is the total points divided by the number of teams.

postconditions.expression: min_ties == sum(result == 0 for result in game_results)
postconditions.description: The number of ties must be minimized and equal to the minimum possible number of ties.
